scheme_name: PM-YASASVI: Top Class School Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description:
The PM-YASASVI scheme stands for the Pradhan Mantri Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India.

This scheme was launched by the Government of India on September 17, 2021.

The primary objective of PM-YASASVI is to provide financial assistance to students from Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), and Denotified Tribes (DNT).

The scheme aims to ensure that these students have access to top-class school education.

The government has set a target to benefit approximately 2 lakh students every year under this scheme.

The scholarship covers students from class 9 to class 12.

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is up to INR 75,000 per year.

This amount is intended to cover tuition fees, boarding, lodging, and other educational expenses.

The scheme is designed to promote education among underprivileged sections of society.

Eligibility for the PM-YASASVI scheme is specifically defined.

Students must belong to the OBC, EBC, or DNT categories.

The annual family income of the applicants should not exceed INR 2.5 lakh.

Students must be in the age group of 9 to 16 years at the time of application.

They must have completed their previous class with at least 55 percent marks.

The application process for PM-YASASVI is straightforward and involves several steps.

Interested candidates must visit the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA).

The application form is available online and must be filled out completely.

Candidates need to provide personal details such as name, age, and category.

They must upload necessary documents including proof of income, caste certificate, and previous academic records.

The application fee for the examination is INR 250 for general category students and INR 125 for reserved category students.

After submitting the application, candidates must prepare for the entrance test.

The entrance test is conducted by the NTA.

The test assesses students on subjects such as Mathematics, Science, and Social Science.

The examination is usually held in the month of August.

Results are typically announced within a month of the examination.

Successful candidates are then eligible for the scholarship.

The disbursement of the scholarship amount occurs in two installments.

The first installment is released at the beginning of the academic year.

The second installment is released after the completion of the first semester.

The implementing authority for the PM-YASASVI scheme is the Ministry of Education, Government of India.

The National Testing Agency is responsible for conducting the entrance examination.

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment also plays a role in the scheme's implementation.

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official NTA website.

The scheme is part of the broader initiative to enhance educational opportunities for marginalized communities.

It aims to reduce the dropout rates among OBC, EBC, and DNT students.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 300 crore for the implementation of this scheme for the first year.

This budget is expected to increase in subsequent years based on the scheme's success.

The PM-YASASVI scheme is aligned with the National Education Policy 2020.

It emphasizes equitable access to quality education for all students.

The scheme also aims to empower students by providing them with the necessary resources to excel academically.

Feedback from beneficiaries indicates a positive impact on their educational pursuits.

Many students report improved academic performance due to the financial support received.

The scheme also encourages students to aspire for higher education and professional courses.

The government plans to monitor the progress of students who benefit from the scheme.

Regular assessments will be conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme.

The PM-YASASVI scheme is a significant step towards achieving social equity in education.

It reflects the government's commitment to uplift marginalized communities through education.

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in society by promoting educated individuals.

This, in turn, can lead to better employment opportunities and economic growth.

The scheme has received widespread support from various educational institutions.

Many schools and colleges are collaborating with the government to facilitate the implementation of the scheme.

Awareness campaigns are being conducted to inform eligible students about the scheme.

These campaigns aim to reach remote areas where access to information may be limited.

The government encourages parents to support their children in applying for the scholarship.

The PM-YASASVI scheme is a beacon of hope for many families struggling to afford quality education.

It is a testament to the government's efforts to create a more inclusive educational landscape.

The scheme is expected to evolve over time based on feedback and changing educational needs.

In conclusion, the PM-YASASVI scheme represents a comprehensive approach to addressing educational disparities.

It provides a structured framework for supporting OBC, EBC, and DNT students.

The financial assistance offered is substantial and aims to alleviate the burden of educational expenses.

With a clear focus on measurable outcomes and inclusivity, the scheme is poised to make a significant impact on the lives of many students across India.
